data.body:
Repair verification report

Problem: pytest failure rendering could print arbitrary ambient credentials returned inside the autodeploy review-drain fixture.

Proven root cause/proof: the fixture copied ordered os.environ; default long traceback renders fixture args through 240-char saferepr. Sanitized sentinel-before-PATH runs leaked; --tb=short did not, proving pytest funcarg rendering was the carrier.

Test: held-out real nested-pytest oracle tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_env_repr_security.py was RED before repair. Its final trigger uses a fake bash on required PATH so the target fails independently of the environment-removal fix. It is GREEN after repair. Restoring dict(os.environ) returned it to RED; the scoped fix was restored.

Fix: tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_review_drain.py now passes only stubbed PATH plus explicit harness variables; DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX/HEALTH_TIMEOUT remain mutable by tests. No dependency, production behavior, or existing assertion changed.

Safety/gates: review-drain plus oracle 15 passed; make lint and make typecheck passed. No ambient credential was used or logged.

Siblings: seven confirmed same-class fixtures were inventoried. Child bug dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran (3402-7143-2e14-4d1a) tracks their parametrized RED-to-GREEN repair; hierarchy already expresses discovery, so rebar correctly rejected a redundant discovered_from link. Parity channels outside pytest fixtures are N/A.

Replication: ordinary default traceback still renders the box fixture on the seeded failure, but its env contains no synthetic sentinel or other arbitrary ambient values.
